title: 2028/29 BRA ELCC Class Ratings
book_use: Chapter 15 primary evidence that capacity value is system-dependent: final 2028/29 ELCC ratings include 7% fixed-panel solar, 10% tracking solar, 59% four-hour storage, 68% six-hour storage, 71% eight-hour storage, 78% ten-hour storage, 96% nuclear, 85% coal, 78% gas combined cycle, and 67% gas combustion turbines; ratings are model outputs for a specific delivery year, not permanent technology attributes
